chats.answer:
The best cassette deck depends on whether you want the highest possible sound quality, a reliable vintage deck, or something you can buy new today.

For pure audio performance, I'd focus on high-end vintage decks from Nakamichi, Revox, Sony ES, and Tandberg. The best models use three heads, sophisticated tape calibration, and excellent transport mechanisms.

My top cassette deck picks
Shop

1. Nakamichi Dragon

Best overall vintage

Legendary automatic azimuth correction, superb playback, three-head design, and Dolby B/C. One of the most desirable cassette decks ever made.

Shop

2. Nakamichi CR-7A

Best for serious recording enthusiasts. Manual playback azimuth adjustment, excellent calibration, and exceptional sound.

Shop

3. Revox B215

Best for precision engineering. Four-motor direct-drive transport, automatic recording calibration, and outstanding stability.

Shop

4. Sony TC-KA7ES

Excellent Sony ES three-head deck with Dolby S, sophisticated calibration, and very high recording quality.

Shop

5. Tascam 122 MKIII

Best professional workhorse. Rugged construction, pitch control, balanced connections, and studio-oriented functionality.

Best cassette decks you can buy new

TEAC W-1200 Dual Cassette Deck - Black

$599.99

Best new deck for home use, dubbing, and USB digitization. Not as high-fidelity as a restored vintage flagship.

TEAC official store

TASCAM 202MKVII Rackmount USB Dual Cassette Deck

$549.00

Best new professional-style option, with rack mounting, dual cassette wells, and USB output.

View retailer

The TEAC W-1200 is also recommended as a leading current-production deck in recent buyer guides. 
StereoNET
+1

Which would I buy?

For maximum sound quality, a professionally serviced Nakamichi CR-7A or Dragon. For best value in vintage hi-fi, a serviced Nakamichi BX-300. For new equipment with a warranty, the TEAC W-1200.

One important question: Are you looking for the best cassette deck ever made, regardless of price, or the best one to buy today within a budget? That changes my recommendation considerably.
